svg.aria-label: The storage pipeline: compress, then encrypt, then erasure-code. Each block records the codec and cipher it was written with, and each fragment carries its own checksum.
svg.title: How a block is stored
svg.desc: Bytes are compressed, then encrypted, then erasure-coded into k data and m parity fragments placed one per failure domain. The block header records the codec and cipher used, so a settings change never reinterprets stored data. Each fragment is checksummed and verified before decoding.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The order is fixed rather than configurable, and every block carries the record of how it was written.

svg.text: A setting is a POLICY for the next write. Held only in configuration, changing it would make every existing block unreadable — so it travels with the block instead.

svg.text: THE STRIPE — HERE AT k=8, m=2, ONE FRAGMENT PER FAILURE DOMAIN

svg.text: Any 8 of the 10 rebuild the block exactly. Two are gone here, and the read still succeeds at full fidelity.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠ Why every fragment carries its own checksum

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A code with m parity fragments corrects m fragments known to be MISSING, but only ⌊m/2⌋ that are present and WRONG — locating a fault costs as much

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: redundancy as repairing it. Without per-fragment checksums, silent corruption on three of ten fragments would decode “successfully” into wrong bytes.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Verifying first turns every ERROR into an ERASURE, which removes the case where reconstruction returns wrong data and reports success.
